items.title: Stage apps spike
items.summary: An app that leaves its card and fills the board, talks both ways with the board, and cards with detail behind a triangle.

node.title: Try it
node.body:
Press **Open** on the app card: the panel fills the board. Pick a feed, then **Raise on the board**: it becomes your note on the card. The agent's reply on the card shows in the app under *From the board*. **Esc** comes back.

+++ What is real and what is not
- The feeds are simulated inside the panel: no keys, no network.
- The frame is the same sandboxed frame as before, moved to the top layer, never reloaded.
- The note is written through the board's one action layer, as your note.
+++

node.title: Ingest
node.body:
Contribution feed arrives.
- SRT or RTMP
- Primary and backup

+++ API detail
`POST /live/slicers` creates the slicer.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `protocol` | `srt` |
| `failover` | `auto` |
+++

node.title: Encode and package
node.body:
One ladder, two formats.
- HLS and DASH
- DRM at the packager

+++ API detail
`PATCH /channels/{id}` sets the ladder.

```
{ "ladder": "hd-6", "drm": true }
```
+++

node.title: Deliver
node.body:
Playback URLs, signed.
- Multi-CDN
- Ad breaks stitched server side

+++ API detail
`GET /channels/{id}/playback` returns the signed URL.
+++
